## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) filled with visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), though she misses [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and deals with questions about their altered relationship.
